summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for STRENSIQ (asfotase alfa, BLA125513). The Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, Medical Review, and Office Director memo all state that the application was not presented to an Advisory Committee; the Office Director memo notes that although Strensiq is a New Molecular Entity, there were no controversial issues warranting AC discussion. Because no committee met, there are no AC-concern-to-change linkages.
